LONG VERSION:

• About our brand and products: 

YUP is a fashion-forward accessories brand, focused particuarlly on premium leather belts. Our products are built for the Urban Cowboys — Young Urban Pioneers who stand out and move with confidence. We design belts with bold, recognisable buckles and a strong identity. Our products sit between minimal and statement, designed to elevate everyday outfits while feeling intentional and wearable.


• What makes us different:

Most fashion brands treat belts as an afterthought — a small accessory added to a clothing collection. YUP is different because belts are our core focus. 

This allows us to push bolder buckle designs, higher-quality finishes, and a stronger identity than brands where belts are secondary.

YUP doesn’t just sell belts — we build statement pieces with a clear attitude and a recognisable community behind them.


• How affiliates can earn: 

Affiliates earn a commission on every sale generated through their unique tracking link or code.

We offer competitive commission rates, real-time tracking, and recurring earnings for repeat customers. Profit is not our top priority; we want to expand. If this affiliate programme goes well, we are open to even more favourable compensation. 


• How to promote us:

Create short-form video content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) such as fit checks, outfit styling, and belt-first looks that show how YUP elevates everyday outfits.


Share lifestyle content with an urban, confident attitude. Buckle Up is more than a tagline — it’s a mindset. Like Just Do It or Red Bull’s stunt culture, it signals readiness: stepping out with confidence and intent.


As a young brand, humour is key. Content can be playful, ironic, and self-aware — bold but not too serious, similar in spirit to brands like Suspicious Antwerp. The goal is to make Buckle Up feel like a cultural cue, not just a slogan.

 

Use direct product tagging or affiliate links in bio where possible.


Creative freedom is encouraged — authentic content always performs best.
